name: average_smul
text: lemma average_smul (c : ℝ) (f : C(X,ℝ)) : average t r x₀ (c • f) = c * average t r x₀ f := by

name: kCoeff_one
text: @[simp] theorem kCoeff_one : kCoeff 1 = 1 := rfl

name: DiscreteF
text: def DiscreteF := Multiplicative F deriving CommGroup
instance : TopologicalSpace DiscreteF := ⊥
instance : DiscreteTopology DiscreteF := ⟨rfl⟩
instance : IsTopologicalGroup DiscreteF := inferInstance

name: DF

instance : MeasurableSpace DF := borel DF

name: embedF

name: embedF_one

name: coe_reF

name: circleOscillation
text: def circleOscillation (r t : ℝ) : ℂ := Complex.exp ((r*Real.cos t : ℝ)*Complex.I)

name: circleOscillation_norm

name: circleOscillation_continuous

name: circleOperator
text: def circleOperator (g : ComplexPlaneL2) : ComplexPlaneL2 := ∫ t, planeTranslate (direction t) g ∂angularMeasure

name: circleAverage
text: def circleAverage (f : ℂ → ℂ) (q : ℂ) : ℂ := ∫ t, f (q+direction t) ∂angularMeasure

name: measurable_eval
text: lemma measurable_eval (a : E) : Measurable (eval a) := (continuous_eval a).measurable

name: eval_zero
text: @[simp] lemma eval_zero (d : D) : eval 0 d = 1 := map_one d

name: eval_scalar
text: lemma eval_scalar (a b : E) (d : D) : eval a (scalar b d) = eval (b*a) d := rfl

name: approxAt
text: def approxAt (i : Finset G × ℕ) (f : G →ᵇ ℝ) : ℝ := cube i.1.toList i.2 f (b i)

name: normSquare
text: def normSquare (f : Func X) : Func X := f * bmConj f

name: char_apply
text: @[simp] lemma char_apply (z : E) (d : D) : char z d = (eval z d : ℂ) := rfl

name: norm_char
text: @[simp] lemma norm_char (z : E) (d : D) : ‖char z d‖ = 1 := Circle.norm_coe _

name: char_zero
text: @[simp] lemma char_zero : char 0 = 1 := by ext d; simp

name: projectedMass
text: def projectedMass (z : E) : ℝ := ‖l2 (μ.map q) (conditional μ q (char z))‖^2

name: projectedMass_nonneg
text: lemma projectedMass_nonneg (z : E) : 0 ≤ projectedMass μ q z := sq_nonneg _

name: normF_coe
text: @[simp] lemma normF_coe (z : E) : ((normF z : F):ℝ) = ‖(z:ℂ)‖ := rfl

name: apply
text: def apply (A : ConvexAverage G) (f : G → H) : H := ∑ i, A.weight i • f (A.pt i)

name: bm
text: def bm (A : ConvexAverage G) (f : Func X) : Func X := ∑ i, A.weight i • act (A.pt i) f

name: limit
text: def limit (f : Func X) : Lp ℂ 2 μ := M.vector (Amenable.Mean.orbit (Amenable.Koopman.action μ) (l2 μ f))

name: limit_measurable
text: lemma limit_measurable (f : Func X) : Measurable (limit μ M f : X → ℂ) := (Lp.stronglyMeasurable _).measurable

name: testSet
text: def testSet (s : Finset ℕ) : Set X := ⋂ n ∈ s, MeasurableSpace.natGeneratingSequence X n
instance : Countable Rot := inferInstanceAs (Countable K)

name: ComplexPlaneL2
text: abbrev ComplexPlaneL2 := Lp (α := ℂ) ℂ 2 volume

name: planePhase
text: def planePhase (h ξ : ℂ) : ℂ := Real.fourierChar (inner ℝ h ξ)

name: planePhase_norm
text: lemma planePhase_norm (h ξ : ℂ) : ‖planePhase h ξ‖=1 := Circle.norm_coe _

name: average
text: def average (F : X × Ω → ℂ) (x : X) : ℂ := ∫ ω, F (x,ω) ∂ν

name: PeriodGroup
text: def PeriodGroup := AF ⧸ AddSubgroup.zmultiples (1 : AF) deriving AddCommGroup
instance : TopologicalSpace PeriodGroup := ⊥

name: realSlice
text: def realSlice : Subfield ℝ := N.toSubfield.comap Complex.ofRealHom

name: iN
text: def iN : N := ⟨Complex.I, hi⟩

name: coe_iN
text: @[simp] lemma coe_iN : ((iN N hi : N) : ℂ) = Complex.I := rfl

name: iN_sq
text: lemma iN_sq : iN N hi ^2 = -1 := by ext; exact Complex.I_sq

name: realLine_one
text: @[simp] lemma realLine_one (a b : realSlice N) : realLine N a b 1 = b := by simp [realLine]

name: Rot
text: def Rot := Additive K deriving AddCommGroup
instance : TopologicalSpace Rot := ⊥
instance : DiscreteTopology Rot := ⟨rfl⟩

name: rotMul
text: def rotMul (g : Rot) : K := Additive.toMul g

name: mulRot
text: def mulRot (k : K) : Rot := Additive.ofMul k

name: rotMul_mulRot
text: @[simp] lemma rotMul_mulRot (k : K) : rotMul (mulRot k) = k := rfl

name: mulRot_rotMul
text: @[simp] lemma mulRot_rotMul (g : Rot) : mulRot (rotMul g) = g := rfl

name: Proper
text: def Proper (ω : E → Fin k) : Prop := ∀ x y : E, ‖(x:ℂ)-(y:ℂ)‖ = 1 → ω x ≠ ω y

name: Space
text: abbrev Space := {ω : E → Fin k // Proper k ω}
instance : CompactSpace (Space k) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (closed_proper k).isCompact

name: trans_apply
text: @[simp] lemma trans_apply (a : E) (ω : Space k) (x : E) : (trans k a ω).val x = ω.val (x+a) := rfl

name: rotate_apply
text: @[simp] lemma rotate_apply (b : K) (ω : Space k) (x : E) : (rotate k b ω).val x = ω.val (kCoeff b*x) := rfl

name: trans_zero
text: @[simp] lemma trans_zero (ω : Space k) : trans k 0 ω = ω := by apply Subtype.ext; funext x; simp

name: trans_add
text: lemma trans_add (a b : E) (ω : Space k) : trans k a (trans k b ω) = trans k (a+b) ω := by apply Subtype.ext; funext x; simp [add_assoc]

name: Trans
text: abbrev Trans := Additive DiscreteE

name: tr
text: def tr (a : Trans) : Space k → Space k := trans k (Multiplicative.toAdd (Additive.toMul a))

name: ro
text: def ro (b : Rot) : Space k → Space k := rotate k (rotMul b)

name: measure
text: def measure (ω : Space k) : Measure (Space k) := EuclideanFiveColor.StationaryMean.measure (tr k) (ro k) ω
instance (ω : Space k) : IsProbabilityMeasure (measure k ω) := inferInstanceAs (IsProbabilityMeasure (EuclideanFiveColor.StationaryMean.measure (tr k) (ro k) ω))

name: op
text: def op (a : A) : H →L[ℂ] H := U (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)

name: op_zero
text: @[simp] lemma op_zero (v : H) : op U 0 v = v := by simp [op]

name: norm_op
text: lemma norm_op (a : A) (v : H) : ‖op U a v‖ = ‖v‖ := Unitary.norm_map _ _

name: mem_space
text: lemma mem_space (v : H) : v ∈ space U ↔ Tendsto (fun a => op U a v) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 v) := Iff.rfl
instance : CompleteSpace (space U) := (isClosed_space U).completeSpace_coe

name: Hilbert
text: abbrev Hilbert := Lp ℂ 2 (measure k ω)

name: clamp
text: def clamp (z : ℂ) : ℂ := (max 0 (min 1 z.re) : ℝ)

name: clamp_zero
text: @[simp] lemma clamp_zero : clamp 0 = 0 := by simp [clamp]

name: realCM

name: realCM_apply
text: @[simp] lemma realCM_apply (f : C(X,ℝ)) (x : X) : realCM f x = (f x : ℂ) := rfl

name: realCM_add
text: @[simp] lemma realCM_add (f g : C(X,ℝ)) : realCM (f+g) = realCM f+realCM g := by ext; simp

name: realCM_sub
text: @[simp] lemma realCM_sub (f g : C(X,ℝ)) : realCM (f-g) = realCM f-realCM g := by ext; simp

name: realCM_smul
text: @[simp] lemma realCM_smul (c : ℝ) (f : C(X,ℝ)) : realCM (c • f) = (c:ℂ) • realCM f := by ext; simp

name: measure

instance : (measure Φ v).Regular := by dsimp [measure]; infer_instance

text: lemma ordinaryIndicator_apply (d : D) : ordinaryIndicator d = (C:Set D).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℂ)) d := rfl

name: binaryQ
text: def binaryQ (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := 1-2*d*Real.cos t+d^2

name: binaryR
text: def binaryR (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := 2*Real.sqrt (binaryQ d t)*Real.sqrt (1-binaryQ d t/4)

name: binaryB
text: def binaryB (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := (Real.cos t-d)/binaryQ d t+Real.sin t/binaryR d t

name: binaryM
text: def binaryM (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.sin t/binaryQ d t+(d-Real.cos t)/binaryR d t

name: binaryE
text: def binaryE (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => binaryB q.1 q.2) (d,t) (0,1)

text: def triangleAngle : ℝ := Real.arccos (5/6)

name: triangleAngle_pos

name: triangleAngle_lt_pi

name: binaryBeta

name: binaryTarget
text: def binaryTarget (d t : ℝ) : ℝ := -binaryCircleMap d (-t)+Real.pi/3

instance : angularMeasure.IsAddHaarMeasure := inferInstanceAs (AddCircle.haarAddCircle (T := 2*Real.pi)).IsAddHaarMeasure

text: @[simp] lemma weakHilbert_apply (v w : E) : weakHilbert v w = ⟪v,w⟫ := rfl

text: def noncoreCost (d : MarkedDisk) : ℝ := if d.core then 0 else d.radius

text: @[simp] lemma moserPoint_2 : moserPoint 2=moserB := rfl

name: moserPoint_3
text: @[simp] lemma moserPoint_3 : moserPoint 3=moserT := rfl

name: moserPoint_4
text: @[simp] lemma moserPoint_4 : moserPoint 4=moserU*moserA := rfl

name: moserPoint_5
text: @[simp] lemma moserPoint_5 : moserPoint 5=moserU*moserB := rfl

name: moserPoint_6
text: @[simp] lemma moserPoint_6 : moserPoint 6=moserU*moserT := rfl

name: moserRotation
text: def moserRotation : ℂ := (35+12*Complex.I)/37

name: placedMoser
text: def placedMoser (i : Fin 7) : ℂ := moserRotation*(moserPoint i+(-290+149*Complex.I)/250)

name: sixty
text: def sixty : ℝ := Real.pi/3

name: Traces
text: abbrev Traces (x : ℂ) := {b : TraceVector k // IsTrace c hc x b}

name: evenOffset_zero
text: lemma evenOffset_zero (v : ℂ) : evenOffset v 0=v := by simp [evenOffset]

name: transverseFirst_zero
text: lemma transverseFirst_zero (v w : ℂ) : transverseFirst v w 0=0 := by simp [transverseFirst]

name: transverseSecond_zero
text: lemma transverseSecond_zero (v w : ℂ) : transverseSecond v w 0=0 := by simp [transverseSecond]

name: radialSide
text: def radialSide (b : Bool) (ε : ℝ) : Set ℝ := if b then Ioo 1 (1+ε) else Ioo (1-ε) 1

name: triangleEdge
text: def triangleEdge (i : Fin 3) : Finset (Fin 5) := if i=0 then {0,1} else if i=1 then {1,2} else {2,0}

name: positiveSector
text: def positiveSector (φ : ℝ) : Set ℝ := {t | 0<Real.sin (3*(t-φ))}

name: negativeSector
text: def negativeSector (φ : ℝ) : Set ℝ := {t | Real.sin (3*(t-φ))<0}

name: fourGroup
text: def fourGroup (s : Fin 3) : Finset (Fin 5) := if s=0 then {4} else if s=1 then {0,2} else {1,3}

name: fourCanonical
text: def fourCanonical (p : Finset (Fin 5)) : Fin 3 := if 4∈p then 0 else if 0∈p then 1 else 2

name: fourState
text: def fourState (x : ℂ) (t : Angles) : Fin 3 := fourCanonical (palette c hc x t)

name: PlaneL2
text: abbrev PlaneL2 := Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure ℂ)

name: scaleHom
text: def scaleHom (n : ℤ) : G →+ G := n • AddMonoidHom.id G

name: scaleHom_apply
text: @[simp] lemma scaleHom_apply (n : ℤ) (g : G) : scaleHom n g = n • g := rfl

name: scaleHom_add
text: lemma scaleHom_add (n m : ℤ) : scaleHom (G := G) (n+m) = scaleHom n + scaleHom m := add_smul _ _ _

name: bound
text: def bound (f : Func X) : ℝ≥0 := f.property.2.choose

name: ext
text: @[ext] lemma ext {f g : Func X} (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) : f = g := Subtype.ext (funext h)

name: add_apply
text: @[simp] lemma add_apply (f g : Func X) (x : X) : (f+g) x = f x + g x := rfl

name: mul_apply
text: @[simp] lemma mul_apply (f g : Func X) (x : X) : (f*g) x = f x * g x := rfl

name: sub_apply
text: @[simp] lemma sub_apply (f g : Func X) (x : X) : (f-g) x = f x - g x := rfl

name: zero_apply
text: @[simp] lemma zero_apply (x : X) : (0 : Func X) x = 0 := rfl

name: one_apply
text: @[simp] lemma one_apply (x : X) : (1 : Func X) x = 1 := rfl

name: smul_apply
text: @[simp] lemma smul_apply (c : ℂ) (f : Func X) (x : X) : (c • f) x = c * f x := rfl

name: lp
text: def lp (p : ℝ≥0∞) (f : Func X) : Lp ℂ p μ := (memLp μ f p).toLp f

name: lift_fst
text: @[simp] theorem lift_fst (z : ℂ) : (lift z).fst = 1 := rfl

name: j_zero
text: @[simp] theorem j_zero : e.j 0 = 1 := e.hom.map_one

name: j_add
text: @[simp] theorem j_add (z w : ℂ) : e.j (z + w) = e.j z * e.j w := e.hom.map_mul _ _

name: j_neg
text: @[simp] theorem j_neg (z : ℂ) : e.j (-z) = (e.j z)⁻¹ := e.hom.map_inv _

name: clip
text: def clip (C t : ℝ) : ℝ := max (-C) (min C t)
instance : Inhabited (OrbitSpace K) := ⟨⟨fun _ => 0⟩⟩
instance : TopologicalSpace (OrbitSpace K) := (equiv K).topologicalSpace
instance : MeasurableSpace (OrbitSpace K) := borel _
instance : BorelSpace (OrbitSpace K) := ⟨rfl⟩

name: measurable_val
text: lemma measurable_val [Countable K] : Measurable (val : OrbitSpace K → K → ℂ) := continuous_val.measurable

name: ordinaryEmbedding_j
text: @[simp] theorem ordinaryEmbedding_j (t : ℂ) : ordinaryEmbedding.j t = j t := rfl

name: act
text: def act (g : G) (f : Func X) : Func X := comp f (fun x => g +ᵥ x) (measurable_const_vadd g)

name: act_apply
text: @[simp] lemma act_apply (g : G) (f : Func X) (x : X) : act g f x = f (g +ᵥ x) := rfl

name: act_mul
text: lemma act_mul (g : G) (f h : Func X) : act g (f*h) = act g f * act g h := rfl

name: act_conj
text: lemma act_conj (g : G) (f : Func X) : act g (bmConj f) = bmConj (act g f) := rfl
instance : CoeFun (Family G X) (fun _ => G → Func X) := ⟨Subtype.val⟩

name: bound
text: def bound (F : Family G X) : ℝ≥0 := F.property.choose

name: norm_le_bound
text: lemma norm_le_bound (F : Family G X) (g : G) (x : X) : ‖F g x‖ ≤ F.bound := F.property.choose_spec g x

name: ext
text: @[ext] lemma ext {F H : Family G X} (h : ∀ g, F g = H g) : F = H := Subtype.ext (funext h)

name: add_apply
text: @[simp] lemma add_apply (F H : Family G X) (g : G) : (F+H) g = F g + H g := rfl

name: mul_apply
text: @[simp] lemma mul_apply (F H : Family G X) (g : G) : (F*H) g = F g * H g := rfl

name: sub_apply
text: @[simp] lemma sub_apply (F H : Family G X) (g : G) : (F-H) g = F g - H g := rfl

name: zero_apply
text: @[simp] lemma zero_apply (g : G) : (0 : Family G X) g = 0 := rfl

name: one_apply
text: @[simp] lemma one_apply (g : G) : (1 : Family G X) g = 1 := rfl

name: real_smul_apply
text: @[simp] lemma real_smul_apply (c : ℝ) (F : Family G X) (g : G) : (c • F) g = c • F g := rfl

name: complex_smul_apply
text: @[simp] lemma complex_smul_apply (c : ℂ) (F : Family G X) (g : G) : (c • F) g = c • F g := rfl

name: orbit_apply
text: @[simp] lemma orbit_apply (φ : G →+ G) (f : Func X) (g : G) : orbit φ f g = act (φ g) f := rfl

name: orbit_add
text: lemma orbit_add (φ : G →+ G) (f h : Func X) : orbit φ (f+h) = orbit φ f + orbit φ h := rfl

name: tensor_apply
text: @[simp] lemma tensor_apply (f : Func X) (g : Func Y) (z : X×Y) : tensor f g z = f z.1 * g z.2 := rfl

name: conj_conj
text: @[simp] lemma conj_conj (f : Func X) : bmConj (bmConj f) = f := by ext x; simp

name: conj_mul
text: lemma conj_mul (f h : Func X) : bmConj (f*h) = bmConj f * bmConj h := by ext x; simp

name: meanNorm
text: def meanNorm (F : Family G X) : ℝ := M.map (Amenable.Mean.normFn (toL2 μ F))

name: measure
text: def measure : Measure X := RealRMK.rieszMeasure (functional t r x₀)
instance : IsFiniteMeasure (measure t r x₀) := by dsimp [measure]; infer_instance
instance : (measure t r x₀).Regular := by dsimp [measure]; infer_instance
